turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Mr. Hale. I have twenty minutes and a client call at 4:40, so start with the zero. Who decided it, and when?
I admire how you fight for your kids. I'd have wanted a mom like you.
Don't manage me, Mr. Hale. Owen's mark is what we're here about. Who decided on the zero?
We really want the same thing here, you and me. We're on the same team.
Then why did my son find out his mark was zero from his phone, in the middle of your class? Answer that.
So as teammates, can we just move forward?
Forward means you answer me. Did you call me before you entered that zero, yes or no?
